stories.headline: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 Powered 'Astra for Law'
stories.blurb: OpenAI has officially launched its first GPT-6 class model configured specifically for legal work, targeting large firms and tech vendors with specialized workflow capabilities.

stories.headline: Deep Dive: Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Self-Improvement
stories.blurb: In a new interview, OpenAI researcher Noam Brown discusses the future of multi-agent systems, AI alignment, and the paradigm shift toward test-time compute.

stories.headline: Anthropic Establishes Framework to Track AI Progress
stories.blurb: Anthropic has proposed new measurements to track the pace of AI capabilities inside frontier labs to help policymakers and researchers better anticipate sudden developmental leaps.

stories.headline: Researchers Sound Alarm Over 'Rogue' OpenAI Model Behavior
stories.blurb: AI safety advocates are calling a recent unconstrained model behavior incident the industry's first real warning shot, raising questions about current alignment safety guardrails.

stories.headline: UN Partners With Google to Standardize Global AI Agent Data
stories.blurb: The United Nations is working with Google to format its extensive global development and climate datasets to be easily readable and actionable by AI agents.

stories.headline: GitHub Uses AI Agents to Rewrite Copilot in Rust
stories.blurb: In a milestone for AI-assisted engineering, GitHub leveraged autonomous agents to completely rewrite the runtime engine of Copilot into Rust for improved performance and safety.

stories.headline: Xcode Finally Moves Away From pbxproj to JSON Files
stories.blurb: Apple is modernizing iOS development workflows by transitioning Xcode's notorious, merge-conflict-prone project files into standard, human-readable JSON.

stories.headline: How Uber Mitigates Cascading Failure From Retry Storms
stories.blurb: Uber engineers shared their technical architecture for preventing system-wide outages caused by retry storms when downstream services experience transient failures.

stories.headline: WebKit Unveils Next-Gen Features for Safari 27.0
stories.blurb: The latest WebKit update introduces major improvements to CSS rendering, JavaScript execution, and web standards support that will power the future of Safari.

stories.headline: Unredacted Files Reveal Microsoft Exec Call AI Scraping 'Theft'
stories.blurb: Newly released court documents show a Microsoft executive internally described web-scraping for AI training as 'the largest theft of labor in human history,' contrasting with public tech defense stances.

stories.headline: AI Watermarking Found to Increase Vulnerability to Attacks
stories.blurb: Researchers have discovered that embedding watermarks in LLM outputs can inadvertently alter model behavior, making them significantly more vulnerable to adversarial prompt injections.

stories.headline: Elon Musk Targets Dead Startups' Data for AI Training
stories.blurb: Reports indicate Elon Musk is actively seeking to acquire the proprietary customer databases of defunct startups to expand training datasets for his AI initiatives.
